description: O11 (data lot, phase 3): the lifecycle of the entity MODEL over an inherited model (job:spec-data: Contact with FK StatusId to the static Status, the action Contact_CountActive with aggregate and filter `Contact.StatusId = Entities.Status.Active`). The mirror of tests/jobs-odc/entity-lifecycle.json. (1) READ entity, attributes, the child `Contact Identifier` (IIdentifierType) and the consumers (the usages of the entity under-reports the FKs, which link to the identifier child). (2) CREATE a related entity by spec with FK and a COMPOSITE unique index (ContactNote), and an attribute + a composite index by raw verbs on the inherited entity. (3) EDIT properties of existing attributes (Length, IsMandatory, Description, DefaultValue, DataType of an attribute WITHOUT consumers). (4) the real consumer already exists (aggregate with filter). (5) RENAME entity and attributes with consumers: filter and FK follow by key, the index name does not. (6) MOVE an attribute. (7) INDEX: change Unique, delete, recreate with another composition. (8) DELETE an attribute without consumers. Headless execution is not a migration of a published database.
